key_insight: Neural triage decoding adaptively spends computation on difficult error syndromes, combining high accuracy with low latency for ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes.
engineering_relevance: The approach could help high-rate quantum error correction keep pace with hardware while reducing physical-qubit overhead.
method: Use a local neural message-passing network to rapidly predict corrections.
Add iterations when residual syndrome violations remain.
Rarely invoke a diversification search to find syndrome-consistent corrections.
evidence_signal: On lifted-product and Kasai codes encoding hundreds of logical qubits, the abstract reports accuracy comparable to near-optimal algorithmic decoders with approximately 10–100× lower decoding latency.
watch_item: Real-time deployment requires checking worst-case latency for difficult syndromes; syndrome consistency alone does not guarantee logical correctness.
paper_title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
